payload.subject: debug.root-cause
payload.decision: Treat the confirmed root cause as the basis for the minimal fix.
payload.rationale: readTokenFromStdin consumes process.stdin until EOF even for a TTY, so Enter cannot advance the HubSpot command to credential storage and result output.

payload.subject: debug.root-cause
payload.decision: Treat the confirmed read-until-EOF behavior of readTokenFromStdin as the basis for a TTY-only first-complete-line fix.
payload.rationale: All callers were traced; Enter yields data but not EOF on actual process.stdin TTY, while redirected input requires EOF compatibility.
